{{translated title}} {{PrevNext |prev=Future Connection |next=One, Two, Three |list=Japanese opening themes |colorscheme=Alola}} {{Song |type=SM OP 04 |language=ja |title=キミの冒険 |transliterated=Kimi no Bōken |translated=Your Adventure |screen=hd |screenshot=OPJ23 13.png |artistname=岡崎体育 |artistname_ro=[[Taiiku Okazaki]] |lyricistname=岡崎体育 |lyricistname_ro=Taiiku Okazaki |composername=岡崎体育 |composername_ro=Taiiku Okazaki |arrangername=野村陽一郎 |arrangername_ro=Yoichiro Nomura |albumtype=album |albumtitle=「劇場版ポケットモンスター　ココ」テーマソング集 |albumtitle_ro=[[Koko Theme Song Collection|Pokémon the Movie: Koko Theme Song Collection]] |catalognumber=SECL-2580/1, SECL-2582 |recordcompany=SME Records |colorscheme=Alola}} '''Your Adventure''' (Japanese: '''キミの冒険''' ''Kimi no Bōken'') is the fourth and final Japanese opening theme of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]''. It debuted as an opening song in [[SM091]], replacing [[Future Connection]], and was replaced by [[One, Two, Three]] of ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'' in [[JN001]]. The full version of the song was first released as a [[List of Pokémon digital singles#Your Adventure|digital single]] on October 7, 2018. ==Opening animation== ===Synopsis=== The opening begins with [[Ash's Pikachu]] waking up and yawning as {{Ash}} beckons it to come with him. Pikachu jumps onto Ash's shoulders just before Ash leaps off a cliff and into the waters below. After the series logo is shown, Ash and Pikachu are shown walking with the Pokémon Ash caught or took care of while in [[Alola]]. As they walk, a film reel containing scenes of Ash and his Pokémon are shown behind them. Ash sadly looks upon a {{i|Poké Ball}} at sunset, only for {{ashcl}} to appear and show that they are there to support him. Ash then happily runs towards them, causing {{an|Sophocles}} to fall over as he tries to dodge Ash. At the [[Pokémon School]], Ash struggles to understand a book during a class, gives up and puts his head on the desk, and is nudged by {{an|Professor Kukui}} to get him to continue. At night, Ash and his Pokémon play together on a beach. At daytime, Ash lays down on a patch of grass with Pikachu, looking at a rainbow in the cloudy skies. Kiawe and his Pokémon train at home, {{an|Lana}} and {{TP|Lana|Primarina}} (formerly her Popplio and Brionne) look at the sea while sitting on some rocks, {{an|Mallow}} and {{TP|Mallow|Tsareena}} are wearing their aprons at [[Aina's Kitchen]], Sophocles, {{TP|Sophocles|Togedemaru}}, and {{TP|Sophocles|Vikavolt}} (formerly his Charjabug) look at the night sky, and {{an|Lillie}} strokes a sleeping [[Snowy]] at her house. In a rocky location, Ash pulls his hat back and sends out {{AP|Lycanroc}} to battle [[Gladion's Lycanroc]]. [[Ash's Rowlet]] and [[Hau]]'s {{p|Dartrix}} fly past Hau before taking to the skies. {{AP|Torracat}} then battles the [[Professor Kukui's Incineroar|Masked Royal's Incineroar]] before Pikachu battles a {{p|Zeraora}}. {{TRT}} and {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}} fantasize about sitting with {{an|Giovanni}} before {{an|Bewear}} crashes into the [[malasada]] truck and squishes their faces into the windshield. At Professor Kukui's house, Ash grabs his backpack and prepares to leave while Rowlet gives a thumbs up to the viewers. In the first variant, an [[Sandy|Eevee]] with shaggy hair happily walks down a dirt path before spotting Ash and his friends walking together and runs up to them. In the second variant, {{al|Dia}} and {{p|Zeraora}} save Ash from a {{p|Guzzlord}}. In the third variant, {{an|Misty}} and the class go [[Mantine Surf|Mantine Surfing]], while {{an|Brock}} and [[Olivia]] fight together. In the fourth variant, Professor Kukui stands in front of the construction site of the Alola League, and envisions himself (as the Masked Royal) and Ash battling there.
